part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in the SVG prop normalization regex at src/diff/props.js:109 — `/xlink[H:h]/` only consumed one character after `xlink`, so `xlink:href` became `hhref`. Changed it to `/xlink:?(H|h)/`, which correctly maps both `xlinkHref` → `href` and `xlink:href` → `href`.

Validation:
- `test/browser/svg.test.js`: all 11 tests pass, including `should support svg xlink:href attribute` (previously failing) and the `xlinkHref` normalization test.
- Full browser karma suite: all pass except one pre-existing, unrelated flake (`focus` capture test in `events.test.js`), which I verified also fails on the unmodified code in headless Chrome.
- `test/shared` + `test/node` mocha suite: 29 passing. ESLint clean.
